clue.text: Twin full of spirit rejected such mysteries

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the assembled letters are read backwards
full of says the word for spirit sits inside the word for twin

parts.note: twins are identical, the same
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: A twin who has been drinking turns away puzzling questions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Twin' as an adjective, identical, gives the word for 'the same'; the whole build is read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Puzzling, inexplicable things are synonyms for mysteries; 'such' points back to the clue's own picture.

clue.text: Result of endless personal belongings

indicators.note: endless means the final letter of the belongings word is dropped

parts.note: effects are personal belongings

explanation.surface: The outcome of someone's never-ending possessions.
explanation.definitionFit: A consequence or outcome is a synonym for result.

clue.text: Dismiss a large part of design, or exclude

indicators.note: a large part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Throw out much of the plan, or simply leave it out.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft gave 'Dismiss a large' as the definition; 'a large part of' is the indicator, since most of 'design' contributes. Hidden: desIGN OR Exclude.
explanation.definitionFit: To disregard or pay no attention to is a synonym for dismiss.

clue.text: Flies prophet across South American capital

indicators.note: across means spanning, so the prophet's name is stretched around the other letters

parts.note: Moses is the Old Testament prophet
Quito is the capital of Ecuador

explanation.surface: A prophet flies over a South American capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flies' looks like a verb but is the plural noun definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Biting gnats are insects of the order of true flies, so they are an example of flies.

clue.text: Dross incorporating new vernacular

indicators.note: incorporating means taking in, so the dross word holds the new letter

parts.note: slag is waste from smelting, dross

explanation.surface: Rubbish mixed in with modern everyday speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal everyday language of a group, its vernacular.

clue.text: Communication of formal agreement to get rid of Republican

indicators.note: to get rid of says one letter is dropped from the agreement word

parts.note: a contract is a formal agreement

explanation.surface: A message about a formal deal designed to oust a Republican.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in touch with someone, exchanging messages, is a synonym for communication.

clue.text: Succeed with Italian — you must be joking!

parts.note: to come off is to succeed, as a plan comes off
It is Italian vermouth, as in gin and It

explanation.surface: Someone told they must succeed with Italian scoffs in disbelief.
explanation.walkthrough: IT for Italian vermouth is a bar-room abbreviation, as in 'gin and It'.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of disbelief telling someone to stop pretending, the same as saying they cannot be serious.

clue.text: Closed union may be set up to employ such a model

indicators.note: in a down clue set up means the hidden letters are read upwards, backwards
the words closed union employ, that is contain, the letters wanted

explanation.surface: A closed-shop union may be established to hire models.
explanation.walkthrough: closED UNion holds EDUN; 'set up' reads it upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's model who poses unclothed is described by this adjective.

clue.text: Reacting rashly perhaps to unusual ill-grace

indicators.note: unusual signals the letters of ill-grace are rearranged

explanation.surface: Responding rashly to uncommon bad manners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rashly' suggests haste, but it means breaking out in a rash.
explanation.definitionFit: Hypersensitive to a substance, often shown by a skin rash, which is a pun on 'rashly'.

clue.text: Number moving south with a need, disheartened

indicators.note: moving signals the letters are shifted about and rearranged
disheartened means the middle of the word need is removed, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: Someone heading south because they are in need and dejected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' turns SOUTH into THOUS; 'disheartened' removes the heart of need, leaving ND.
explanation.definitionFit: A figure equal to ten hundred is an example of a number.

clue.text: Things smokers use to protect new teeth

indicators.note: to protect means to surround, so the cigarettes wrap around the letter for new

parts.note: fags is British slang for cigarettes

explanation.surface: Smokers' habits supposedly shielding fresh teeth.
explanation.walkthrough: FAGS is everyday British slang for cigarettes.
explanation.definitionFit: Long pointed teeth, as of a snake or dog, are a kind of teeth.

clue.text: Drama at sea with sick old creature

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters of drama are rearranged

parts.note: sick means ill

explanation.surface: A play on a ship featuring an ailing ancient beast.
explanation.definitionFit: This armoured South American mammal is an example of a creature.

clue.text: Irascible type's gone out after seeing dog dirt

indicators.note: after seeing places the jumbled letters behind the dog and dirt words

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog
mud is dirt

indicators.note: out means wrong or disordered, so the letters of gone are jumbled

explanation.surface: A grumpy person storms off after spotting dog mess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dog dirt' reads as one thing, but it is two pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A bad-tempered, cantankerous person, usually old, is exactly this kind of irascible type.

clue.text: Leaves with no parking skills

indicators.note: with no says the parking letter is removed

parts.note: parts means leaves, departs
P is the map abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: Someone drives off, having no talent for parking.
explanation.definitionFit: Crafts and skills: the word means abilities or techniques, as in the arts of persuasion.

clue.text: Trained surgeons will accept credit for parasites

indicators.note: will accept means taking in, so the rearranged letters hold the credit letters
trained means arranged, so the letters of surgeons are rearranged

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit

explanation.surface: Qualified surgeons will take payment for treating parasites.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trained' looks like it describes the surgeons, but it signals their letters being rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: People who sponge off others are metaphorical parasites.

clue.text: Amazement of criminal upset splinter group

indicators.note: criminal suggests something bent or wrong, so the letters of upset are rearranged

parts.note: a faction is a breakaway group within a party

explanation.surface: Shock at a breakaway group disturbed by lawbreaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'criminal' turns UPSET into STUPE; 'upset' looks like the anagram signal but is the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Being stunned or dazed with astonishment is a synonym for amazement.

clue.text: Suggest job with university behind schedule

parts.note: a post is a job
late means behind schedule

explanation.surface: Someone proposes a university job that is running late.
explanation.definitionFit: To put forward a hypothesis or claim, to propose, is a synonym for suggest.

clue.text: Choices underpinning island church's help for climbers

indicators.note: in a down clue underpinning puts the choices word below the others

parts.note: CE stands for the Church of England; the 's joins it to what follows
picks are choices

explanation.surface: Options supporting an island church's aid to mountaineers.
explanation.definitionFit: Small axes used to cut steps in ice are tools that help climbers.

clue.text: Relaxed at home because mother left

parts.note: in means at home
for means because
ma is mother

explanation.surface: Someone at ease at home because their mother has gone.
explanation.definitionFit: Casual, not formal or stiff, is a synonym for relaxed.

clue.text: Metamorphosis contains a tense exchange of words

indicators.note: contains says the change word holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: a metamorphosis is a conversion, a change of form
T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: A transformation produces an edgy talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tense' looks like an adjective for the exchange but gives T.
explanation.definitionFit: A talk between people is literally an exchange of words.

clue.text: Good point that hurt, filling time unoccupied

indicators.note: filling says the cry of pain goes inside
unoccupied means the inside of the word time is emptied, keeping only its outer letters

parts.note: the word time emptied
ouch is what someone says when hurt

explanation.surface: A remark that stung, made during free time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unoccupied' leaves TE from time; OUCH fills it.
explanation.definitionFit: The fencing cry, used in argument to concede that an opponent has scored a good point.

clue.text: Fanatic's beginning to expect much after the last letter

indicators.note: after puts the other pieces behind the last letter

parts.note: Z is the last letter of the alphabet

indicators.note: beginning to says take the first letter of expect

parts.note: a lot means much

explanation.surface: A zealous person's start to expecting a great deal.
explanation.definitionFit: An extremist, uncompromising in their beliefs, is a synonym for fanatic.

clue.text: Scheme corporation has to employ student

indicators.note: to employ means to take in, so the belly word holds the student letter

parts.note: corporation is an old humorous word for a pot belly
L for learner, as on a British learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A company's plan to hire a trainee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'corporation' is the old jokey word for a paunch, not a firm.
explanation.definitionFit: A secret plan or plot is a synonym for scheme.

clue.text: Corner with talk of flower display

definitions.meaning: to detain someone and talk at them, as if gripping their coat
a flower worn in a lapel

explanation.surface: Trapping someone to chat about a floral arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to accost and detain in conversation; the noun is a flower pinned in the lapel hole.

clue.text: Took a corner with no right to be on pitch

indicators.note: with no says the letter for right is removed

parts.note: turned means took a corner

explanation.surface: A footballer took a corner kick without the right to be on the field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pitch' suggests a football field, but it is musical pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: An instrument that is correctly adjusted in pitch is in tune.

clue.text: Curry favour, seeing supporter welcome wife

indicators.note: welcome means take in, so the supporter word holds the wife letter

parts.note: a fan is a supporter

explanation.surface: Sucking up to someone, a fan greets their wife.
explanation.definitionFit: To flatter servilely, to grovel, is to curry favour.

clue.text: Egomaniac should be upset and sorry

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the letters of the word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A self-obsessed person ought to be distressed and apologetic.
explanation.definitionFit: Said when you did not catch something, asking for a repeat, just as 'sorry?' is.

clue.text: Do very well in old prison when cut off

parts.note: ex means former, old

indicators.note: cut off means its end is removed, dropping the last letter of the prison word

parts.note: a cell is a prison room

explanation.surface: Thriving in a former jail after being isolated.
explanation.definitionFit: To be outstanding, to shine at something, is to do very well.

clue.text: The French must be in because there's quiet

indicators.note: must be in says the French article goes inside the because word

parts.note: since means because
le is French for the

explanation.surface: The French must stay home, which explains the hush.
explanation.definitionFit: Silence and quiet are synonyms: the absence of sound.

clue.text: Son will be taken in by respectable lineage

indicators.note: taken in by says the son letter goes inside the respectable word

parts.note: decent means respectable

explanation.surface: A son fooled by people of good family.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancestry or family origin, as in 'of royal descent', is lineage.
